tasks.label: git-hooks:create-pre-commit-config
args:
cat > .pre-commit-config.yaml << 'EOF'
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.4.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-added-large-files
      - id: check-merge-conflict
  - repo: https://github.com/psf/black
    rev: 23.1.0
    hooks:
      - id: black
        language_version: python3
  - repo: https://github.com/pycqa/isort
    rev: 5.12.0
    hooks:
      - id: isort
        args: ["--profile", "black"]
  - repo: https://github.com/pycqa/flake8
    rev: 6.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: flake8
EOF
echo 'Created .pre-commit-config.yaml'

@'
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.4.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-added-large-files
      - id: check-merge-conflict
  - repo: https://github.com/psf/black
    rev: 23.1.0
    hooks:
      - id: black
        language_version: python3
  - repo: https://github.com/pycqa/isort
    rev: 5.12.0
    hooks:
      - id: isort
        args: ["--profile", "black"]
  - repo: https://github.com/pycqa/flake8
    rev: 6.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: flake8
'@ | Out-File -FilePath '.pre-commit-config.yaml' -Encoding utf8; Write-Host 'Created .pre-commit-config.yaml'

tasks.label: git-hooks:create-commitlint-config
git-hooks:list-hooks
args: ls -la .git/hooks/ | grep -v sample || echo 'No custom hooks found'
Get-ChildItem -Path '.git/hooks/' -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike '*sample*' } | Format-Table Name, Length, LastWriteTime

tasks.label: git-hooks:test-hooks
args: echo 'Testing pre-commit hooks...' && pre-commit run --all-files && echo 'Testing commit message validation...' && echo 'feat: test commit message' | npx commitlint
Write-Host 'Testing pre-commit hooks...'; pre-commit run --all-files; Write-Host 'Testing commit message validation...'; 'feat: test commit message' | npx commitlint

tasks.label: git-hooks:uninstall-hooks
args: pre-commit uninstall && rm -rf .husky && echo 'Git hooks uninstalled'
pre-commit uninstall; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .husky -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Git hooks uninstalled'
